sin.name: mark-written-outside-listener
sin.description: A chat mark is written by a call to a card writer outside a listener: from a command handler, a controller, a support class, a job or the engine, so the mark is not written where its event happens.
sin.rule: A chat mark is written by a listener on the event the change raises: move the call into a listener of features/<feature>/listeners that hears that event, and let the command or support class only change the row that carries the event.
